name: 80465 · Morrison, CO
findings: ZIP 80465 (Morrison) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80465 (Morrison) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80465 (Morrison) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
